$description: Curated by hand: what a piece of UI IS -> which design-system component(s) to use. This is the decision layer an AI reads when given an image, a text request or a Figma frame. scripts/generate/ai-manifest.mjs FAILS if any component named here no longer exists, so this file cannot drift silently.

intents.intent: Application frame (nav rail + top header + page content)
cues: narrow dark-navy rail on the left with stacked icon+label items
white bar across the top with logo, region/time and user
intents.notes: AppShell is a layout helper (not from Figma). LeftNav: menus[], selectedMenu. Header: region{}, profile{}. Never hand-build the rail or the header.

cues: small home icon, chevrons between words, last item darker and not a link
intents.notes: ContextBarPanel wraps Breadcrumbs and optional status chips/actions on the right.

intents.intent: Page title with tools and a primary action
cues: large semibold title with a grey line under it
a navy button on the right, maybe with a chevron (split button)
intents.notes: ListHeaderPanel is built on DataGridToolbar (tools are Plain IconButtons). A button with an attached chevron is ButtonGroup, its menu is DropdownMenu.

intents.intent: Tabs with a status/count filter on the same row
cues: underlined tab labels on the left
a row of count pills (Total 19, 5 Approved ...) on the right
intents.notes: StatusFilterBar is Figma statusFilterv2. Pass divider so the baseline runs edge to edge.

cues: header row (navy filled or light grey)
rows with text, links, avatars, status pills, row actions
intents.notes: Cells: id/link -> DataGridLinkCell (SemiBold, underline on hover); plain text and avatar+name -> DataGridTextCell (icon slot takes an Avatar); status -> Status type=chip; actions -> DataGridActionsCell with IconButton. filledHeader = navy header.

cues: coloured pill with text (Approved, Draft, Rejected ...)
intents.notes: Single record status -> Status (type chip | textWithBadge | text | textWithIcon). Tag/label -> Chip. Filtering a list by status -> StatusFilterBar. Count/dot on an icon -> Badge.
Button color: primary | error | success | warning | ai. Sizes xsmall..xlarge. AI action = Button color=ai (there is no separate GradientButton).

cues: label above, bordered box, hint line below
intents.notes: Always via FormField layout (TextField/Select already do). Sizes small 32 / medium 40 / large 44.
A group with a title -> CheckboxGroup/RadioGroup. Segmented control -> ToggleButtonGroup (Text or Icon).

intents.intent: Dates, time, files and rich content
cues: formatting toolbar over a text area
coloured banner with icon and optional action
intents.notes: Notification: color blue|green|orange|red, variant leftStroke|fill, isSnackbar for toasts. Flyout = right panel; Modal = dialog.

cues: titled panel with a tinted header
intents.notes: Page background around cards is PageBodyContentPanel (surface canvas, 16px padding).

cues: big number with label and a coloured left edge
intents.notes: Charts are SVG building blocks; pulseChartTheme gives the Figma colours for recharts.
UI glyphs come from src/icons (import { FilterIcon } from 'src/icons'); never use MUI icons in pages.
